About this site

J’s Apps brings together small Android apps that come in handy when you study, look after your phone, need to work something out or just want a short break.

What this site does

It gives a short introduction to each app and points you to that app’s own homepage, where you can see its screens and features and go on to Google Play.

Most of the apps here are small and focused on one job: a study notebook, a tool to check your phone, a calculator or a quick game to take a break.

The apps

There are 18 apps here, sorted into 5 groups by what they are for. The groups change as more apps are added.

  • Language & culture5

    Learn Korean and English expressions, Korean history for the CSAT, Western art history and the Catholic Bible with cards, quizzes and notes

    Korean Study, English Proverbs Dictionary, CSAT Korean History, Art History Note, Catholic Bible Quiz

  • Math & science5

    Math and physics formulas, chemistry calculations, hands-on function and shape experiments, and resistor calculations

    Math Formula Note, Math Lab, CSAT Physics Formula Note, Chemistry Note, Resistor Calculator

  • Phone4

    Check your phone, compare smartphone specs, show a cheering LED board and find Wi-Fi dead zones at home

    PhoneCheck, Phone Spec, Phone LED Board, WiFi DeadZone

  • Stocks & investing2

    Work out average cost and returns on stock trades, and compare investing methods in a virtual market

    Stock Trade Calculator, Stock Simulator

  • Play & relax2

    A puzzle game about bending and mixing light, and a relaxing snow globe to watch

    Chroma Ray, Snow Globe

How the app information is written

Each description is written after checking the app’s homepage and its Google Play listing. Apps change with updates, so please see each app’s homepage and Google Play for the latest details.

You can read this site in Korean and English, but each app supports its own set of languages. Some apps, such as the CSAT physics, Korean history and math formula apps, are made for students preparing for Korea’s CSAT.

The illustrations and list icons on this site set the mood and tell the apps apart. They are not actual app screens.

Contact

For questions about an app, please use the developer contact on that app’s Google Play page.
